name: taobao-mcp
description: Taobao (marketplaces): me, list_products, get_product, list_sales, list_refunds. Every tool maps to

platform_mcp_taobao_app_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TAOBAO_APP_KEY
platform_mcp_taobao_app_key.description: AppKey of your Taobao Open Platform (TOP) application (open.taobao.com console).

platform_mcp_taobao_app_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TAOBAO_APP_SECRET
platform_mcp_taobao_app_secret.description: AppSecret of the same application; signs every call as upper-case MD5(secret + parameters sorted by name as name+value + secret) and is never sent.

platform_mcp_taobao_session.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TAOBAO_SESSION
platform_mcp_taobao_session.description: The seller's authorised session (access_token) from the TOP user-authorisation flow (https://open.taobao.com/doc.htm?docId=102635&docType=1); sent as the `session` parameter. Update it when it expires — the runtime does not refresh it.

tools.name: me
tools.description: taobao.user.seller.get: the authorised seller (user_id, nick, type B/C, seller_credit, status).

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: taobao.items.onsale.get: the seller's items currently on sale (出售中), newest listing first; price in CNY (元). Items in the warehouse (instock) are not included, so the `status` input is not applied.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: taobao.item.seller.get: one of the seller's items by num_iid with its SKUs (skus.sku) and description HTML.

tools.name: list_sales
tools.description: taobao.trades.sold.get: trades sold in the last three months, newest first (status WAIT_BUYER_PAY, WAIT_SELLER_SEND_GOODS, TRADE_FINISHED, …; payment in CNY). `since` (ISO date/datetime) is sent as start_created in yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss and is read by Taobao as GMT+8. The product fields are the first order line; `product_id` input is not applied.

tools.name: list_refunds
tools.description: taobao.refunds.receive.get: refunds buyers requested from the seller (WAIT_SELLER_AGREE, WAIT_BUYER_RETURN_GOODS, WAIT_SELLER_CONFIRM_GOODS, SELLER_REFUSE_BUYER, CLOSED, SUCCESS); `since` filters start_modified (GMT+8).
